The
Philippines
is
home
to
the
Carabao
Mango
—
the
world’s
sweetest
mango
and
a
major
delicacy
of
the
country. Every Filipino household has had the
mangga
in
their food — from salad to snacks to dessert to candies.

Unfortunately there aren’t a lot of options for me to bring
mangoes there – so I’ll settle for one of my favorite forms
of it. The dried mango is one of my favorite sweet snacks
and I will never pass up an opportunity to eat some.

But do note that its fiber-y structure may make your throat
itch if you eat too much too quickly in one sitting. It’s like
when you eat too much pineapple and your mouth starts
to sting — but a milder and less annoying version of that.
